rules: Primitive JSON carrier types do not by themselves define FermentationJSON semantic types.
An omitted optional BeerJSON property is distinct from null, zero, false, and an empty string. The pinned BeerJSON schemas do not define null as a value for these fields.

BeerJSON enum tokens are source-format tokens. Importers preserve the exact token; a native FermentationJSON vocabulary mapping may use a different identifier but must retain enough source information for reverse mapping.
Matching names, producer strings, product IDs, or equal object content do not establish identity between distinct embedded BeerJSON object occurrences.
Importers must not invent units, time zones, scale bounds, default values, or reference identities that are absent from BeerJSON.

generic_primitive_policy.string: Preserve exact Unicode string content. Do not infer identifiers, URIs, years, or controlled vocabulary membership unless the field-specific BeerJSON schema establishes that role.
generic_primitive_policy.boolean: Preserve true/false exactly; absence remains distinct from false.
generic_primitive_policy.enum: Preserve the exact BeerJSON token and map to a native token only through an explicit field/type vocabulary mapping.

date_type.timezone_policy: A BeerJSON local date-time has no zone/offset. It MUST NOT be converted to an RFC 3339 instant by assuming UTC or a local zone. Preserve it as local date-time semantics until an external source supplies a zone.
date_type.calendar_validation_policy: The pinned BeerJSON regex checks only digit shape and is unanchored; it does not establish a real calendar date. Strict compatibility preserves any source accepted by the pinned schema. Native date/local-date-time interpretation requires both a whole-string lexical form and calendar-valid fields; otherwise preserve the source string and report a compatibility diagnostic rather than inventing or repairing a date.
date_type.native_mapping_policy: Only a whole-string lexical match to YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS is eligible for native calendar/local-date-time semantics. A string that satisfies the pinned BeerJSON JSON Schema only because the unanchored pattern matches a substring MUST remain source-preserved without invented date semantics.

version_type.rule: The pinned BeerJSON schema does not constrain VersionType to 1.0. FermentationJSON BeerJSON-1.0 compatibility therefore treats a root version numerically equal to 1.0 as a semantic profile requirement; other numbers are outside the BeerJSON-1.0 compatibility claim even if structurally accepted by the upstream schema.

percent_type.range_policy: BeerJSON PercentType imposes no 0..100 bound. Importers MUST NOT clamp or reject a source percentage solely because it is outside that conventional range; preserve the BeerJSON value and let the native field/domain profile apply any scientifically justified constraint.

numeric_field_rules.rule: BeerJSON describes dextrinizing units but supplies neither an explicit unit token nor analytical method. Preserve the number and description semantics; do not invent a FermentationJSON unit or scale.
The field name explicitly defines mL oil per 100 g hops. Convert exactly to L/kg with factor 0.01 while preserving the original bare BeerJSON number and field identity.
BeerJSON provides no unit token. Preserve the number and do not infer volumes CO2 or g/L.
Interpret as the numeric number of packaging vessels. BeerJSON permits any JSON number, so import MUST NOT silently round a fractional source value.
The field description fixes the basis as dots per inch. Preserve exactly; a future packaging schema may define a dedicated resolution quantity without treating dpi as generic dimensionless data.
Width is incomplete without the sibling units field. Map the pair to an explicit length quantity; if units is absent, preserve width without inventing a unit.
Height is incomplete without the sibling units field. Map the pair to an explicit length quantity; if units is absent, preserve height without inventing a unit.
BeerJSON provides no unit token. Preserve the number and do not infer volumes CO2 or g/L.

The field name gives a calorie-per-pint shape but BeerJSON does not define which calorie realization or pint system applies. Preserve the number and field identity without inventing energy or serving units.
BeerJSON defines no rating range or scale. Preserve the numeric score exactly and do not normalize to 5, 10, 20, 100, or another scale.
Treat the BeerJSON number as one exact reported pH value. Do not infer an average, measurement temperature, or reference condition.

integer_field_rules.rule: Maximum reuse count; preserve integer exactly.
Field name explicitly scales the integer by 10^9 cells.
Category identifier/label component, not a measured quantity.
BeerJSON description uses 2 to mean the second process step; preserve the ordinal and do not silently convert to zero-based indexing.

identity_and_reference_policy.deduplication: MUST NOT merge distinct BeerJSON object occurrences solely because descriptive fields match.
identity_and_reference_policy.generated_native_ids: An importer MAY assign FermentationJSON object IDs as part of native representation, but generated IDs are not evidence that the BeerJSON source contained identity or reference semantics.
